baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spring, drinking verb, servants, and doubled causative opening form all occur inside 76:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible water-source supplies the servants, who are active operators rather than only consumers: they split openings and channels so its water runs outward.

activation_trace.role: The flowing spring branch supplies the source reservoir in the hydraulic mechanism.
Literal imbibing supplies the servants' reception of water from the source.
Worshipful service identifies the drinkers while the following verb gives those servants operational agency.
The fixed divine name marks the servants' affiliation and the source of their status.
Wide splitting, outflow, and opened watercourses supply the servants' channel-making action.

changed_reading.before: God's servants drink from a spring.
changed_reading.after: God's servants drink from a source that they also open and route, making beneficiaries into active stewards of its flow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional link to drinking and the emphatic causative opening permit a source-to-access network inside 76:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A common spring is converted into multiple reachable drinking shares or places by opening distributive channels from it.

activation_trace.role: The water-eye branch provides one common flowing source.
The allotted-water branch turns drinking into apportioned access rather than undifferentiated consumption.
The drinking-place branch supplies endpoints reached from the common source.
Opened channels provide the distribution links between source and drinking places.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents an abundant spring.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a source whose abundance becomes usable through an actively made network of shares and drinking points.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'they drink' then 'they make it burst forth' joins reception to release in 76:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is imbibed and allowed to permeate inward is converted, through worshipful service, into generosity that overflows outward.

activation_trace.role: Permeation and inward admixture make drinking a model of received provision becoming internal.
Devoted service supplies the disposition that converts reception into action.
Overflowing generosity supplies the outward result of what the servants have received.

changed_reading.before: Drinking and opening the spring are two adjacent actions.
changed_reading.after: The two actions form a reception-to-circulation mechanism: provision enters the servants and reappears as abundant giving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice places a filled cup and its mixture before an accusative spring; the second spring is explicitly located and named. The mirror makes the focus spring read as the upstream source or mixing supply behind the cup, while its opened channels distribute that supply.

activation_trace.role: The springing water-source is the candidate upstream reservoir in the repeated cup-source pattern.
Literal drinking connects the upstream spring to what the cup delivers.
Opened watercourses explain how the source can feed more than one drinking endpoint.
The cup together with its contents supplies the first receiving vessel immediately before the focus spring.
Mixing one thing with another makes the spring a plausible ingredient-source for the first cup.
The second filled cup repeats the same vessel position in the later sequence.
The second mixture repeats the compositional relation that precedes a spring.
The later flowing spring confirms that the repeated terminal noun can denote a literal water-source.
Naming as identification makes the later spring a determinate source and sharpens the structural parallel.

structural_cues: 76:5-6 and 76:17-18 repeat the order cup, mixture, then spring.
The later spring is explicitly located and named, clarifying the function of the earlier indefinite spring by parallelism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored order and literal source branches; I infer that each spring specifies an upstream component or supply for its preceding cup. A live alternative is that each spring is only an additional nearby amenity rather than the cup's source.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a generic drink source mentioned after the cup.
changed_reading.after: The spring is the upstream supply underlying a cup-and-mixture system, and the servants actively route that supply into accessible flows.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the drink scene, connected rings and collars constrain bodies, while a second shackle branch even images blocked pouring. Against that material blockage, God's servants drink and open watercourses; belonging to God is therefore paired with mobility and effective agency rather than coercive immobilization.

activation_trace.role: The owned-status branch keeps the social force of the designation 'servants' visible in the contrast.
Worshipful obedience distinguishes divine service from the coercive restraint in the preceding scene.
Opening channels supplies the positive reversal of bodily and hydraulic blockage.
Connected rings materially supply the chain that restricts movement before the focus scene.
A collar that binds a limb supplies bodily immobilization as the foil to active channel-making.
The branch of cloth that stops poured water gives the restraint image a direct hydraulic counterpart.

structural_cues: The chain-and-shackle scene in 76:4 is followed immediately by drinking in 76:5-6.
The servants themselves are grammatical agents of the repeated causative opening in 76:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily restraint, a pour-blocking material image, and active water-opening; I infer an adjacent reversal between coerced bondage and empowered divine service. The alternative is a simpler punishment-versus-reward contrast with no claim about kinds of servanthood.

changed_reading.before: 'Servants of God' is chiefly a passive title for rewarded drinkers.
changed_reading.after: Their divine belonging is paradoxically an unbound, effective service: they can move, drink, and make channels where the opposing scene binds bodies and blocks flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first opposes gratitude to covering, then places camphor from the covering root in the cup immediately before the spring bursts open. Later the servants seek no thanks while their own striving is thanked. The open source can therefore image gratitude as letting a received gift show its increase rather than covering or hoarding it.

activation_trace.role: Inward permeation supplies receipt of a gift whose effect can later become visible.
Overflowing generosity supplies the outward, non-hoarded effect of received provision.
Acknowledging a benefit supplies the explicit grateful alternative that frames the servants.
Fullness and abundant yield give gratitude a material image of increase suited to a gushing source.
Covering a blessing supplies the ethical opposite of making its flow visible.
The camphor branch places the same root materially inside the cup just before the focus opening.
The refusal to solicit gratitude removes reciprocal praise as the motive for outward provision.
A small input whose effect becomes manifest supports the pattern of service returning as visible abundance.

structural_cues: 76:3 explicitly sets grateful and covering responses against one another.
The covering root recurs as camphor in 76:5 immediately before the opened spring, while gratitude recurs in 76:9 and 76:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root recurrence, the covering-versus-gratitude opposition, and branches of increase and overflow; I infer that opened circulation is a material enactment of gratitude. The live alternative is that camphor is only an aromatic ingredient and the repeated root carries no ethical reversal.

changed_reading.before: The servants consume a fragrant reward and make its spring flow.
changed_reading.after: Their opening of the source can also enact gratitude: received abundance is de-covered, made effective, and circulated without demanding thanks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drinkers immediately become providers who move sustenance toward a person without support and a person physically bound, solely toward God and without recompense. This turns the focus's inward drink and outward gush into a social irrigation pattern: provision is routed to blocked or cut-off endpoints.

activation_trace.role: The branch in which wealth is consumed in feeding and watering bridges personal drinking to expenditure for others.
Devoted service supplies the identity of those who turn receipt into provision.
Expansive benefaction supplies the outward-flow function of the opened source.
Giving food to another supplies the concrete transfer from beneficiaries to providers.
A child cut off from a supporter supplies a socially disconnected endpoint for provision.
Binding and confinement supply a recipient whose mobility and access are materially blocked.
The face as the self supplies God-directed purpose rather than recipient-directed return.
Reciprocal compensation supplies the return flow that the providers explicitly decline.

structural_cues: 76:7-9 continues with plural actions attributable to the righteous group introduced around the focus scene.
The recipient list in 76:8 culminates in the captive, followed by an explicit denial of recompense in 76:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward feeding, disconnected and bound recipients, God-directed purpose, and refused compensation; I map the focus's opened watercourses onto that social transfer. The alternative is that the fountain and feeding are parallel rewards and deeds without a shared distribution mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fountain is an inward luxury enjoyed by the servants.
changed_reading.after: Its receive-and-release motion models the servants as conduits who carry provision toward people cut off from ordinary support or access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later provisions are brought near, made easy after difficulty, and fitted to exact measure. Repeated emphatic cognate constructions link that responsive environment to the focus's emphatic opening, revising a violent rupture into controlled, user-responsive routing.

activation_trace.role: Wide opening and watercourses provide the infrastructure whose manner is revised by the later accessibility cues.
Nearness supplies an environment whose goods come within reach of their users.
Making something tractable and easy after difficulty supplies responsive access rather than forceful struggle.
Exact fit to a measure supplies controlled proportion for the vessels and, by analogy, the routed flow.

structural_cues: The emphatic pairs in 76:6, 76:14, and 76:16 repeat a finite verb with its cognate verbal noun.
Near shade, facilitated fruit, and measured vessels form one accessibility sequence around the later drink service.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity, facilitation, exact fit, and formally parallel emphatic constructions; I infer that the water opening belongs to the same responsive design. A live alternative is that opening remains forceful abundance while only fruit and vessels are customized.

changed_reading.before: The servants force a spring to burst open with overwhelming power.
changed_reading.after: They operate a tractable environment in which water can be opened and routed with the same accessibility and proportion seen in fruit and vessels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord later waters them with a drink that can purify beyond itself, and the closing will statement nests human willing inside divine willing. The servants' causative opening is therefore real but derivative agency: they operate and distribute a source whose gift, ownership, and enabling remain divine.

activation_trace.role: Worshipful service supplies responsive human agency rather than independent ownership.
The divine name marks whose servants act and places their agency inside that relation.
The causative opening preserves a genuine servant-level action that needs an upstream source.
Causing water to be given identifies the Lord as the upstream provider of the drink system.
Lordship, ownership, and mastery locate ultimate control of the provision above the servants.
A purifying medium that cleanses beyond itself gives the supplied drink an outwardly effective capacity.
Will attached to an intended thing supplies the explicit nesting of creaturely choice inside divine choice.

structural_cues: 76:6 assigns the opening verb to the servants, while 76:21 assigns the watering verb to their Lord.
76:30 explicitly conditions plural human willing on God's willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both levels of causative agency and the final will condition; I infer an upstream-provider and downstream-operator relation. The alternative is that the two drink scenes describe distinct gifts and that 76:30 limits willing generally without specifying fountain operation.

changed_reading.before: The servants appear to control the spring autonomously.
changed_reading.after: Their agency is active but delegated: the Lord supplies and enables the drink, while the servants open its downstream courses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later declaration of caused descent and delivery, intensified by a cognate verbal noun, formally echoes the focus's caused opening and outflow. Joined to drinking as understanding and Quran as recitation, the fountain can secondarily model received communication being opened into distributable channels.

activation_trace.role: Drinking as grasping or understanding permits the received liquid to carry a secondary cognitive function.
Opened branching courses supply the distribution side of the communicative analogy.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies an upstream act of delivery parallel to the spring's release.
Reading and recitation identify the delivered content whose availability could spread through opened routes.

structural_cues: 76:6 and 76:23 each intensify a causative plural verb with a cognate verbal noun.
76:23 moves from the reward scene to the delivered Quran before commands of endurance and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formal echo, delivery, recitation, understanding, and branching flow; I supply the cross-domain arrow from water distribution to communication distribution. A live alternative is that the repeated syntax is only emphatic style and the focus remains exclusively hydraulic.

changed_reading.before: The servants open only physical watercourses.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary analogy, they can image recipients who internalize a delivered recitation and open routes through which it becomes available.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from a literal spring into perception, understanding, and daybreak. It remains anchored in three exact focus-root branches and is activated by the later morning-after-long-night sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary dawn afterimage, never as a replacement for the hydraulic reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence can join the eye's manifest seeing, drinking as understanding, and the same root's dawn-breaking branch in the repeated opening verb.

activation_trace.role: Direct eyewitness encounter supplies manifest perception at the start of the secondary sequence.
Absorbing as understanding converts seen presence into inward comprehension.
Dawn breaking from night supplies outward illumination as the result of what was perceived and absorbed.
The first part of day gives the dawn branch an explicit later temporal foothold.
Night and its darkness supply what the dawn image breaks from.
Extended duration makes the commanded night vigil a sustained prelude to morning opening.

changed_reading.before: The servants make water burst from a spring.
changed_reading.after: A secondary wordplay lets their received perception or understanding break outward like dawn after sustained night worship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because a water-spring is not literally cash. It remains anchored in the focus root's present-wealth branch, water allotment, generous outflow, and the later refusal of compensation; downstream prose should label it an economic analogy for liquid, present provision rather than a lexical gloss of the spring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus spring can activate the root's ready-wealth branch while allotted water and overflowing generosity keep the analogy tied to its drinking and opening verbs.

activation_trace.role: Present tangible wealth, opposed to deferred debt, supplies the economic side of the liquid-resource analogy.
An allotted water share supplies distributable claims on the common resource.
Overflowing generosity changes present wealth from a held asset into released provision.
Collecting and settling a debt supplies the transactional return that the servants refuse to seek.
Seeking an object supplies the explicitly negated pursuit of repayment from recipients.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a plentiful natural amenity.
changed_reading.after: As an economic analogy, it is present liquid wealth made shareable through generous release, with no debt collected from those who receive it.

strongest_changes: The mirrored cup-mixture-spring sequences make the focus spring an upstream supply that can be routed, not merely scenery beside a drink.
The chain-and-shackle foil and the later feeding of cut-off recipients recast God's servants as active conduits whose service opposes blocked bodies and blocked provision.
Near, facilitated, and exactly measured amenities revise forceful bursting into responsive channel operation.
The Lord's later watering and the final will condition preserve servant action while locating its source and enabling in divine agency.
The gratitude-covering root pattern permits opened flow to image a gift made visible and circulated rather than concealed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed repeated cup-source architecture, adjacent blockage-and-flow reversals, and several cognate-accusative constructions; together they changed a static reward image into a layered mechanism of reception, routing, service, and delegated agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise force of the preposition in the drinking clause remains open and affects whether the spring is source, means, or accompaniment.
The two named or described springs may establish a shared architectural pattern without being the same source.
The gratitude, revelation, dawn, and economic readings are branch-backed resonances, but their intended scope is less certain than the literal hydraulic model.
The context supports responsive access, but it does not explicitly state how freely or where the servants may route the water.
